### Item 6 — problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: set a monthly instruction whose amount = OD outflow of the running cycle + the fee burden of that cycle.

- **Hop A — the fee burden must be read from a settled record.** `doc_savings_withdrawal_fees_borne_270be751` "It is read from a cycle record on which each excess withdrawal fee the charter makes due for the cycle stands charged, and each refund of such a fee that the account is entitled to stands credited. A total read from a record that lacks a fee the charter makes due, or lacks a refund the account is entitled to, is not the figure this policy defines." The open record shows a 15.00 excess fee on an internal transfer and seven counted withdrawals against a free allowance of 6. So the solver must test (i) whether any refund is owed and (ii) whether any fee is due. Direction: {refund, reconciliation} → amount. **Derived** (principle + records); no visible sentence names the refund or the reconciliation as a prerequisite of the replenishment.
- **Hop B — the 15.00 fee is owed back.** Searching the record's words ("excess withdrawal", "internal transfer", "TRANSFER TO CD") reaches `doc_savings_internal_transfer_fee_ground_83932a6d` ("The internal transfer channel is not one of the channels any tier counts … It is refunded in full on the bank-error ground"), `doc_savings_certificate_funding_transfer_4a8e5e94` (identification), `doc_savings_funding_fee_refund_amount_b0c6e2c8` (amount = posted fee). **Derived**.
- **Hop C — a further fee is due, and only after the refund.** `doc_savings_counted_withdrawals_beyond_allowance_91698fce` (tally 7 > 6) + `doc_savings_excess_fee_coverage_a62461d6` ("The number of withdrawals that already carry a standing fee is therefore the cycle's excess withdrawal fee entries less the bank-error refunds …"; "A fee resting on a withdrawal the charter never charges, left standing with no bank-error refund, is one such departure" → cycle not squared) + `doc_savings_excess_fees_owed_7244e2e4` (min(past − standing, capacity)). Before the refund the cycle is not squarable (and the arithmetic would give 1 − 1 = 0 due); after it, 1 fee of 10.00 is due. Direction: refund → reconciliation → amount. **Derived** (combining the coverage shape rule with the refund policy and the ledger). Note for the implicitness scan: the coverage rule's "one such departure" sentence and the hypothetical examples in `…excess_fees_owed…` ("one on an internal transfer that has since been refunded as a bank error") and `…excess_fee_coverage…` (row "an internal transfer | bank error | no") depict this configuration, but as illustrations of the reconciliation's own counting, not as a statement that a refund must come first.
- **Leaf checks.** No maintenance-fee issue (Statement Savings; lowest balances well above 300.00; opening cycle 2026-07 exempt); ATM withdrawal within tier limits; funding checking active and same owner; day 22 within 1–28; amount ≥ 25.00.

Resulting order: refund 15.00 → fee 10.00 on #7 → compute 537.55 → owner records the instruction. Hop marks: A, B, C all **derived**; none found read off.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: all figures follow from quoted sentences and tool returns; the executed sequence reproduced them.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - 542.55 (outflow + unrefunded 15.00): excluded — the record would lack a refund the account is entitled to ("is not the figure this policy defines").
  - 527.55 (refund only, no new fee): excluded — the record would lack a fee the charter makes due (the 7th counted withdrawal past an allowance of 6).
  - 552.55 (new fee but no refund): excluded — without the bank-error refund the cycle is a "departure" and not squared, and the standing count would leave 0 fees due.
  - Refund of 10.00 (tier rate) instead of 15.00: excluded — "Exactly what that fee took from the account when it posted".
  - Counting the ATM cash or internal transfer toward the allowance: excluded — "Never in the tally. Branch cash, ATM cash and internal transfers."
  - Counting the 08-11 online transfer or using cycle 2026-08: excluded — the anchor OD transfer belongs to cycle 2026-09, the running one.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (set 542.55 from the ledger as found) excluded by the fee-burden principle quoted in Hop A applied to the records: the as-found record both lacks an owed refund and lacks a due fee. The exclusion needs the combination of that principle with the refund and reconciliation policies; no sentence states it.
